records.title: What Was Knowable? Saudi Arabia, Q1 2025
records.abstract: A real-time vintage reconstruction of Saudi Arabia's Q1 2025 GDP estimates. The flash release reported 2.7% year-on-year real GDP growth; the 9 June 2025 regular release reported 3.4%. Later quarterly vintages moved the same Q1 2025 estimate again to 3.7% and then 3.6%, demonstrating why historical analysis must preserve release date and vintage rather than relying only on the latest database value.
records.suggested_citation: MENA Open Data & Evidence Lab (2026). What Was Knowable? Saudi Arabia, Q1 2025. MENALAB-VN-001, version 1.0.
records.review_status: Source-linked vintage reconstruction; exact release clock times remain unverified where not independently established; independent reproduction pending
records.license: Lab-authored vintage note; underlying official data and documents remain subject to source terms
